latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of aistatus skill:

- Check real-time status of major AI providers (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Google).
- Search and view availability, context length, and pricing for AI models.
- View trending AI models based on usage data.
- Access LLM benchmark leaderboard and compare model rankings.
- Get recent incident and outage reports across AI providers.
